name: Stuart Favretto
description: Stuart Favretto is a product manager at Garmin with a background in product design and a passion for golf.
socialImageAlt: Stuart Favretto — product manager and product designer
introduction: I currently live in Kansas and work at Garmin, overseeing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Garmin Golf app.

Originally from Canada, I moved to San Francisco to study Design and play competitive college golf. After graduating, I stayed in San Francisco to build my design career at LUNAR Design and Nokia before joining Garmin.
